entities.name: Augustin Joseph Schulte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Augustine Joseph Schulte was an American Catholic priest and professor at St. Charles Borromeo Seminary in Pennsylvania, who served as the interim rector of the Pontifical North American College in Rome from 1884 to 1885.
